_comment: Template. Copy to <userData>/agent-army.config.json — on macOS that is ~/Library/Application Support/Agent Army/agent-army.config.json — and fill in your deployment's values; a deployment's filled copy is the deployment's own. Every value here is public configuration; no credential belongs in this file and the app refuses one that carries a secret-shaped key. `first_mate.tier` is First mate's standing tier (1-10, default 8 = fable low; Config > First mate model sets it); the app writes `first_mate.override` itself when a timed override is set from the First mate strip.
